india.one_line: Sarvam AI's new inference platform hosting Chinese models sparks debate, while ServiceNow reports widespread security incidents across Indian organisations.

themes.title: Sarvam AI hosts Chinese models
themes.text: Sarvam AI launched Token Factory, serving six Chinese models alongside two others on Indian GPU servers, reigniting debates over India's sovereign AI priorities following government subsidies.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI launches Token Factory hosting mostly Chinese models on Indian GPUs, reigniting sovereign AI debate
Sarvam AI hosts six Chinese models in India, reigniting sovereign AI debate

themes.title: Indian organisations face AI security incidents
themes.text: A ServiceNow survey revealed that 92 percent of Indian organisations faced AI agent security incidents, with only 36 percent resolving them within a day.

stories.headline: 92% of Indian organisations hit by AI agent security incidents, survey shows

themes.title: Google rolls out Tasks in India
themes.text: Google launched its agentic AI assistant Tasks for free in India and five other markets, enabling users to handle calls, bookings, and purchases.

stories.headline: Google rolls out Gemini Tasks assistant for free in six markets

themes.title: Hackers target NBFCs with AI
themes.text: Delhi-NCR non-banking financial companies lost over Rs 65 crore to hackers using malware and suspected AI to divert approved loans.

stories.headline: AI-assisted hackers breach Delhi-NCR NBFCs and divert Rs 65 cr
